programme.title: The Inspire Action Podcast
programme.sub-title: Super Seaweed Solving the Plastic Problem (with Pierre Paslier, Notpla)
programme.desc: SUPER SEAWEED TO THE RESCUE! No, this seaweed hasn’t been genetically modified to fight off mutants–it’s just working to combat the plastic crisis, of course! One of the most dire issues our world today faces is the overproduction and overconsumption of plastic. With waste streams ill-equipped to handle the volume and varying types of plastic, as much as 23 million metric tonnes of plastic end up in our world’s waterways each year! Not only is this plastic choking marine life and ecosystems, but it’s also having devastating impacts on human health, communities, and economies. Founded in 2014, Notpla is on a mission to eliminate single-use plastic packaging with their innovative seaweed-based product. Their seaweed packaging is entirely biodegradable, organic, and made from seaweed harvested for industrial use (no fishy habitat destruction here!) In this episode, Ciara and Pierre discuss the plastic crisis, Notpla’s incredible 2022 Earthshot Prize win, how their work is eliminating tens of millions of pieces of single-use plastic across Europe and the UK, their future ambitions to use their product to better our world.

We've visited this Olympic Village twice before—once just before the games, and again right after they ended. Now, 1 year on, we're here to see the exciting reality: how this Olympic legacy is truly benefiting the local community. We spoke with the visionaries who built it, the experts studying its impact, and the locals who are using these incredible facilities every single day. programme.title: Going Green: Green Green World
programme.sub-title: Every Building in 2050 Will Be Covered in MOSS!
programme.desc: This is why moss is the future of sustainable architecture! Alive Labs in London, are growing moss panels that can be installed in cities to help remove air pollution, suck up carbon dioxide, regulate the temperature and absorb rainwater! Moss’ potential has not been fully harnessed in architecture until now. It’s fire-resistant due to the modular shape, requires very little maintenance and the shapes can be customised to create moss artwork! The surrounding material is also the world's first bio receptive concrete made from fully organic materials. Building facades offer so much opportunity to reintroduce biodiversity into cities. This is a practical, easy to install solution, which we hope to see in cities around the world soon.

programme.title: Syusy Blady Ai Confini Della Realtà
programme.sub-title: Syusy Blady Ai Confini Della Realtà S2 Ep6 - Con Alessandro Morbidelli
programme.desc: Intervista ad Alessandro Morbidelli, uno degli scienziati planetari più attivi nel cercare di capire la situazione attuale del sistema solare e uno dei principali ispiratori di modelli matematici che hanno riscosso molto di successo nella comunità astronomica, tra cui i più famosi e apprezzati sono il cosiddetto "Modello di Nizza", nato per spiegare l'origine dell'intenso bombardamento tardivo, e il modello "Grand Tack", che cerca di spiegare, tra le altre cose, l'inaspettata presenza dell'acqua...

programme.title: Robin Lewis Makes
programme.sub-title: Mistakes Can Happen At Any Time On Site
programme.desc: This video documents my first-ever cabinet installation for a paying client — from cutting melamine sheets in the workshop to scribing fillers on site and figuring things out the hard way. I walk through the entire cabinetry process: breaking down materials, sizing parts, installing drawer hardware, fixing mistakes, and dealing with walls that are nowhere near plumb. If you’re interested in cabinet making, furniture building, or starting a small woodworking business, this project shows what the job actually looks like — not just the clean highlight reel. This was the last project of 2025 for me, and a big learning curve — especially around quoting install time, managing client expectations, and understanding where profit actually comes from in cabinetry work. If you’re growing a trade business, thinking about taking on installs, or just curious how cabinet makers price jobs, this one’s for you.

programme.title: Robin Lewis Makes
programme.sub-title: The Most Expensive Plywood I've Ever Worked With
programme.desc: I’m building a custom L-shaped shoe rack using premium Tasmanian Oak veneered plywood with a solid Victorian Ash seat. This project was a great client commission and a fun build, but with timber prices skyrocketing—and Victorian Ash becoming harder to source after the 2023 logging ban—it definitely pushed the limits of my margins. If you’re interested in furniture making, woodworking commissions, or want to see what it’s like working with high-end Tasmanian Oak plywood, this video walks through the full process: design, cutting, joinery, assembly, and installing the solid timber seat. I also talk about pricing custom furniture and how difficult Victorian Ash is becoming to find now that legislation has restricted harvesting.

programme.sub-title: Is The Laser Industry Evolving Quick Enough?
programme.desc: The laser engraving world is exploding — but has it evolved too fast for beginners to keep up? In this video, I dive into my experience setting up the Omtech Turbo 756 60W CO₂ laser, from the initial unboxing to the unexpected issues that exposed some growing pains in the laser industry. If you’re new to laser engraving, thinking about buying a CO₂ laser, or just curious about how the industry is shifting from industrial to residential spaces, this is a must-watch. I cover what worked, what didn’t, and why it feels like the laser engraving community is still catching up to the speed of its own innovation. The laser engraving industry is growing fast — but are we ready for it? Let’s find out.

programme.title: Robin Lewis Makes
programme.sub-title: The Most Beautiful Desk I've Ever Built
programme.desc: Ever thought about making a desk out of end grain? In this video, I take the idea of end grain parquet flooring and flip it on its head — turning it into a custom end grain desk build made entirely from timber offcuts. I walk through the full process of milling, gluing, pattern design, and flattening — essentially creating an end grain board on a massive scale. Along the way, I dive into the big question every woodworker faces: can you glue wood that moves to something that doesn’t? From concerns about wood movement, moisture, and cracking, to experimenting with epoxy and creative inlay work, this project became a long-term experiment in how far you can push the rules of woodworking. Watch the full video to see how I turned a pile of offcuts into a functional, geometric end grain desk — and find out if it actually survived.

programme.title: The Far Frontier
programme.desc: Willis Newcomb and Bart Carroll head a gang engaged in smuggling wanted-American criminals back into the United States from Mexico. Operating from Sharperville, an oil town on the American side of the border, they transport their human cargo in oil drums loaded on trucks. Border Patrolman Tom Sharper intercepts one of the trucks but is overpowered and left for dead. Carroll, having already been paid for the job and not wanting any evidence to walk around, get caught and lead back to him, backs the human-cargo trucks to the edge of a cliff and sends the drums crashing to the boulder far below. Judge Cookie Bullfincher and Border Patrolman Roy Rogers conduct a search for the missing Tom, but the crooks have gone back for him and find him in a state of amnesia. They rob the bank and pin it on Tom. It is now up to Roy to clear his friend and also put an end to Carroll's human-smuggling racket.

programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. programme.title: Angels of Revolution
programme.desc: Set in 1934, the film is inspired by the real events of the Kazym Uprising. The natives - Khanty and Nenets - reject the new ideology, preferring to believe in their gods and goddesses. Polina's art troupe, consisting of a composer, a filmmaker, a theater director, an architect and a sculptor, travels north to penetrate the illiterate minds of the isolated taiga.

programme.title: Bella Solitaria
programme.desc: Go Dok Mi es una editora de libros, bastante tímida, se niega a abandonar su apartamento o interactuar con la gente de su alrededor lo mayor posible. Cada día, ella recibe de forma anónima una caja de leche con un Post-it pegado, el que sigue una historia uno tras otro. Todos los días, usando un par de binoculares de color amarillo ella mira a su vecino de enfrente, Han Tae Joon. La última vez que estuvo fuera, fue en un parque en un día de otoño, se había enamorado de Tae Joon, a primera vista, lo continuo mirando y se dio cuenta que adoptó un perro. Cuando miró por la ventana y vio que el vivía en el apartamento de al frente, ella lo asocio al destino.

Nichee au cœur des rues animees et des ruelles du quartier musulman, l’eglise Sainte-Anne, la mieux conservee des eglises croisees de Jerusalem, se distingue par sa tranquillite. Elle se trouve dans une cour entouree d’arbres et d’arbustes.

Venere depuis des siecles, il possede une grande importance religieuse, notamment dans la tradition chretienne comme lieu de la Transfiguration, et offre des vues panoramiques impressionnantes sur le paysage environnant.

programme.title: Indonesia: Bosques de lo extraño
programme.desc: Los Exploradores se adentran en un mundo extraño y desconcertante en los últimos bosques de Indonesia. Los árboles son el epítome de la rareza, como las higueras estranguladoras: estos gigantes asfixian al árbol que los cobija y al mismo tiempo dan cobijo a una fauna increíble.

programme.title: Kursi, Parc National, Israel
programme.desc: Le parc national de Kursi en Israel est un site archeologique et historique situe sur la rive est de la mer de Galilee. Il conserve les vestiges d’un monastere et d’une eglise byzantins, traditionnellement consideres comme le lieu du miracle des porcs de Geraseens par Jesus, et offre aux visiteurs des vues panoramiques, des mosaïques anciennes et un aperçu de l’histoire chretienne ancienne.

programme.desc: Dramedy Frontalwatte- feature debut by Jakob Lass and his graduation film from from film school jumpstarted the German Mumblecore movement. With his brother, actor and director Tom (PAPA GOLD), Jakob Lass has developed a fresh, improvisation-based style, including his own manifesto, FOGMA.

programme.title: Hippos, Israel
programme.desc: Hippos (Sussita) est une ancienne ville greco-romaine situee sur une colline surplombant la mer de Galilee dans le nord d’Israel. Fondee a l’epoque hellenistique, elle a prospere en tant que partie de la Decapole et est aujourd’hui connue pour ses impressionnantes ruines, ses rues, ses temples, sa basilique et ses portes de ville, temoignant d’un riche melange de culture classique et d’histoire chretienne ancienne.

programme.title: El Vuelo de Polynesia des islas Societe y Tuamotu
programme.desc: The Explorers parte hacia las encantadoras islas de la Sociedad y Tuamotu, en la Polinesia Francesa, siguiendo la estela de los grandes exploradores. Atolones y lagunas de aguas cristalinas, rodeadas de arrecifes de coral: Tetiaroa es un santuario de tortugas y aves marinas.

Esta expedición aérea nos ofrece otra mirada a bosques profundos y milenarios, montañas de vegetación exuberante, islas paradisíacas, una cultura ancestral, una laguna y arrecifes de coral que albergan ecosistemas intactos poblados por una biodiversidad notable.

programme.title: Tel Afek (Fort Antipatris), Israel

La ville fortifiee de Tel Afek, a mi-chemin entre Jerusalem et Cesaree, se trouve aujourd’hui dans un parc calme et silencieux. Le site est proche des sources perennes de la riviere Yarkon et fait desormais partie du parc national de Yarkon en Israel. Plus de 6 000 ans de villes successives se sont construites sur la colline surplombant les sources de la riviere Yarkon.

programme.title: Johanna Dohnal - Visionary of Feminism
programme.desc: Dohnal worked in the SPÖ from 1956 and was a minister from 1979 to 1995. Under her leadership, rape within marriage became punishable, guardianship of unmarried mothers was abolished, sexual harassment became a criminal offense, and expulsion in cases of domestic violence became law. Women's shelters, gender quotas, and equal treatment laws were established for the first time.

De la terrasse de l’eglise, la vue sur la vieille ville de Nazareth est exceptionnelle, divisee en quartiers orthodoxe, catholique romain et musulman.

Pour être au plus près d'une civilisation et d'une nature en pleine mutation, pour témoigner de l'évolution de la vie sur ces terres glaciales, l'expédition a parcouru le Grand Nord Canadien, du printemps au début de l'hiver.

programme.title: Atlas
programme.desc: 60-year-old Walter (Rainer Bock) is a removal man for evictions. He is the most loyal hauler that Walter's boss Roland Grone (Uwe Preuss) has in his shipping company. Walter ignores the pain his backbreaking job causes him as well as the suffering of the people whose privacy he invades on a daily basis. Grone is planning a risky real estate deal with the help of the shady Afsari family clan.

programme.title: El Gran Inventario del Planeta: Ártico canadiense
programme.desc: El reinado del hombre blanco. Los miembros de la expedición The Explorers parten al descubrimiento del Ártico canadiense, una región emblemática de los trastornos climáticos que afectan a nuestro planeta. Para acercarse lo más posible a una civilización y una naturaleza en plena mutación, y ser testigos de la evolución de la vida en estas tierras heladas, la expedición recorre el Extremo Norte canadiense, desde la primavera hasta principios del invierno.

programme.title: Amor Musical
programme.desc: Todo inicia cuando son transferidos a la escuela Jung San que recibe auspicio por parte de una fundación millonaria y poderosa. Como es de esperarse, los días escolares en esta escuela se convierte en una lucha sin fin. Cada día enfrentan el gran abismo entre el rico y el pobre. Ante la cruda realidad, en lo único que pueden confiar es en su música. Tocar con sus amigos es la única cosa que los mantiene vivos, al mismo tiempo, Su música los hace brillar por encima de los demás. “Amor Musical” es un drama musical como nunca antes visto; al mejor estilo y creado para el sentimiento punk.

programme.title: Mann im Spagat- Pace, Cowboy, Pace
programme.desc: Cowboy has a vision. He wants to save the planet with his Free Swingers, so he applies for a grant at The Central Agency. They send a representative named Fey of Sweden to approve Cowboy's proposal. She demands results and he decides to stage a charity bicycle rally featuring a roster of Berlin misfits on two wheels.

programme.title: Le Grand Inventaire de la Planète: Nouvelle Calédonie, au Pays des Merveilles de la Terre
programme.desc: The Explorers, menée par Olivier Chiabodo, a déployé ses équipes pour réaliser, en images, l’inventaire des merveilles naturelles d'une terre découverte par l’explorateur anglais James Cook en 1774 : la Nouvelle-Calédonie. Mais également découvrir la culture des premiers habitants de l'île, les Mélanésiens.

programme.desc: Halvor Sunde fra Risør åpner dørene til sin egen garasje, som blant annet huser en strøken Hotrod. Asgeir besøker Arild og hans Ferrari, og gir ham en hjelpende hånd når motoren skal settes inn. Videre går turen til Gatebil on ice i Sigdal.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1980-1990
programme.desc: 80-tallet er preget av racinglegender. En ny verdensmester kommer på banen, og viser frem motorer med 1.200 hester. Porche 959 er den raskeste landeveisbilen i verden. Motorsport har mer å si enn noen gang, og tiårene er fyllt med store motorer.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1947-1960
programme.desc: På slutten av 1940 og 1950 går vi mot en ny start. Etter krigen nærmest stoppet bilutviklingen og produksjonen helt opp, men produsenter fra Frankrike, England og USA begynte sakte bygge biler til sivile igjen.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1960-1970
programme.desc: 1960-tallet er fargerikt og bilmarkedet vokser. Småbiler er blitt veldig populære, og middelklassen er på utkikk etter bil. Hvis du har råd, vil drømmen din gå i oppfyllelse.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Opel Astra Electric im EAS
programme.desc: Kein anderes Auto hat Alexander Bloch bisher in ein solches Wechselbad der Gefühle geschmissen. Von „sensationell!“ bis „macht ihr Witze?“ ist alles dabei. Was die Stärken und Schwächen des Opel Astra Electric sind und ob er sich gegen den VW ID.3 behaupten kann, erfahrt ihr hier!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Audi Concept C: "Audi, ihr traut euch was!"
programme.desc: Audi war in den letzten Jahren beim Design eher weniger mutig. Auch bei der Qualität hinkten die Ingolstädter ihrem eigenen Anspruch hinterher. Mit dem Audi Concept C wagt die Marke einen radikalen Schritt: Eine neue Designsprache, die Anleihen an frühere Audi-Ikonen nimmt. Dazu hochwertige Materialien und eine spürbar bessere Qualität.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Comeback des Wankelmotors - So funktioniert die Technik
programme.desc: Nach einem Jahrzehnt feiert der Wankelmotor sein Comeback! Das ungewöhnliche Motorkonzept hatte in der Vergangenheit einige Probleme, weshalb die Produktion eingestellt wurde. Wie ein Wankelmotor funktioniert, wo seine Schwachstellen sind und warum er im neuen Mazda MX-30 R-EV wieder eingesetzt wird, erfahrt ihr mit Alexander Bloch.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - 5 Fehler: Deshalb ist WLTP bei E-Autos Schwachsinn!
programme.desc: Mit dem WLTP-Verbrauch sollte alles besser werden: Endlich realistische Angaben zum Verbrauch eines Fahrzeugs und keine geschönten Mini-Verbräuche. Doch ist das wirklich so? WLTP ist vor allem für Verbrenner optimiert worden, für Elektro-Autos ist das Verfahren aus verschiedenen Gründen unbrauchbar. Die fünf größten WLTP-Fehler im Zusammenhang mit E-Autos hat Alex im Video.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Das Reifen-ABC: Alles, was ihr über Reifen wissen müsst!
programme.desc: Alexander Bloch ist zu Besuch bei Quick Reifendiscount in Gelsenkirchen. Passend zur Reifenwechselsaison klären wir euch auf, worauf es bei der Wahl der Reifen ankommt und wann es an der Zeit ist, eure Schlappen zu wechseln.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Stehen Hybrid-Autos vor dem Aus?
programme.desc: Der Hybrid, also die Kombination aus Verbrenner und Elektromotor, hat aufgrund seiner Eigenschaften einige Erfolge verzeichnet. Er führte die Kunden an die Elektromobilität heran, bot aber gleichzeitig die Sicherheit, auf Langstrecken ohne Bedenken und ohne ständige Pausen voranzukommen. Reine Elektroautos müssen sich heute dank höheren Reichweiten auch nicht mehr verstecken. Gerät der Hybrid zunehmend in Vergessenheit? Alexander Bloch klärt auf!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Tesla Model 3 Highland: Weltklasse, aber patzt in manchen Sachen
programme.desc: Das Tesla Model 3 galt zeitweise als meistverkauftes Elektroauto in Deutschland und auf dem Kontinent. Was macht Tesla so besonders und was kann das neue Update? Alex Bloch bittet das frisch geliftete Tesla Model 3 Highland zum ersten Check.

programme.title: Airplane Vs. Volcano
programme.desc: Un aereo di linea rimane intrappolato all'interno di un anello di vulcani in eruzione. I passeggeri e l'equipaggio devono trovare un modo per sopravvivere ad alta quota, senza atterrare. Quando, però, la lava e le ceneri scatenano paura e sfiducia tra tutti, non sono solo i vulcani a essere pericolosi. Tutti devono imparare a collaborare se vogliono sopravvivere a questo epico volo di fuoco.

programme.title: Brace For Impact - Indagine Ad Alta Quota
programme.desc: Tensione alle stelle in questo thriller che vede l'esperta di disastri aerei Sofia coinvolta in un'indagine per far chiarezza sulle reali cause di un tragico incidente in cui ha perso la vita il fratello. Il suo desiderio di giustizia la porterà a infrangere le regole del servizio di intelligence e a scoprire un complotto terroristico.

programme.title: Air Collision
programme.desc: Una tempesta solare spazza via il sistema di controllo del traffico aereo. I passeggeri dell'Air Force One e quelli di un jet di linea si ritrovano in rotta di collisione nei cieli sopra il Midwest.

programme.title: Airline Disaster
programme.desc: Una squadra di terroristi dirotta un aereo di linea statunitense, lo Starquest, il più avanzato e grande aereo passeggeri del mondo. Quando Harriet Franklin, Presidente degli Stati Uniti, apprende che sull'aereo viaggia anche suo fratello, è chiamata a scegliere tra la sua famiglia e la sicurezza delle persone nelle città sottostanti, qualora il velivolo fosse costretto a schiantarsi al suolo.

programme.title: Flight Of Fear - Terrore Ad Alta Quota
programme.desc: I passeggeri e l'equipaggio di un volo vengono attaccati da forze invisibili che minacciano tutti a bordo, causando panico e caos.

programme.title: Road Wars - Benvenuto All'inferno!
programme.desc: Road Wars - Benvenuto all'inferno!

programme.title: The Recall - L'invasione
programme.desc: Charlie (RJ Mitte) si unisce ai suoi amici durante un weekend, in una cabina sul lago. Quella notte, un raggio di luce ultraterrena spunta giù dal cielo e rapisce gran parte del gruppo, portandolo sulla nave madre. I due superstiti, Charlie e Annie, devono fare affidamento su un eccentrico e misterioso cacciatore locale (Wesley Snipes), che sembra avere già esperienze dell'attacco.

programme.title: Ice 2020 - Parte 1
programme.desc: E ‘il 2020. I risultati di uno scienziato ambientale, il Professor Thom Archer suggeriscono che Halo, l’impresa di perforazione della società energetica sul ghiacciaio della Groenlandia ne stanno causando lo scioglimento. Gli avvertimenti di Archer vengono ignorati, così si dirige verso l’Artico per trovare prove inconfutabili. Al suo arrivo, si rende conto che l’umanità è in pericolo immediato, e corre a casa per salvare la sua famiglia. Il ghiacciaio collassa, con conseguenze devastanti...

programme.title: RAZOR: Coral Babies and Seagrass
programme.desc: In part-1 of the the show, The race to save the world's coral is on. These vital organisms are being devastated by mass bleaching events caused by climate change. At current rates, 99% could perish in marine heatwaves by the 2030s. To help ensure their survival, scientists are urgently working to reproduce coral species and restore reefs. RAZOR's Reya El-Salahi visits the landlocked University of Derby—75 miles from the sea—where Dr Michael Sweet and his team are pioneering coral breeding techniques. programme.title: Foodwise: Veggie Beijing
programme.desc: Beijing is a 3000-year old metropolis home to a dizzying array of culinary traditions, not least of which is vegetarian cuisine. For Beijingers, eating vegetarian is the best way to welcome spring. In this episode, Tianran and Angela take up the challenge: From simple home cooking utilizing spring flowers and leaves, to the extravagant mock-meat masterpieces of imperial cuisine, and international dishes well-known to the vegetarian community, our hosts discover a plethora of plant-based options to be found amongst the historic alleys and skyscrapers of China's capital.

programme.title: Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain
programme.desc: Porcelain has shaped the culture of the whole world. The wisdom behind each of 72 procedures has been refined from generation to generation. The times may change, some techniques may change, but what remains the same is the burning flame of the kiln that keeps setting so many hearts on fire for this ancient craft.

programme.title: Ancient melodies, modern vibes: Sang Tian's music
programme.desc: Chinese traditional music is often seen as something rooted in the past. But singer-songwriter Sang Tian is finding new ways for it to live in the present. He calls himself a "translator," fine-tuning ancient melodies into a modern musical language.

programme.title: China Bound：Suzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He visits Suzhou, a historic city in eastern China famously admired by Marco Polo. Crisscrossed by canals, Suzhou is renowned for its exquisite gardens, where ancient scholars recreated nature's beauty within their own homes. Tianran discovers a city of refined tastes, where even a bowl of breakfast noodles comes with unspoken etiquette, locals insist on only in-season produce, and foodies eagerly await the arrival of prized hairy crabs.

programme.title: China Untapped: Changsha
programme.desc: The city of Changsha is one of central China's powerhouses. It's a leader in both the construction machinery industry and in media – Changsha was China's first UNESCO "Creative City". It's also one of China's best-known cities for its nightlife. The soul of a city is in its people, and this episode focuses on the women of Changsha who are helping to innovate, change and further develop this city they call home.

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.1
programme.desc: When Zhejiang's winding river meets the sea it encounters a coastal region studded with islands. On this journey we survey a land of bays, bridges and harbors that is a glorious archipelago of memory, history and culture...

programme.title: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing
programme.desc: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing delves into the historical origins and cultural background of Fengdu Ghost City, and also features the Zhongyuan Festival celebrations and ancestor-worshipping rituals held here. These activities reflect the local people’s positive and optimistic outlook on life and death, as well as the great importance they attach to their ancestors, families and family traditions.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-4 Medieval Combat
programme.desc: Episode 4 centres on Shanghai, where Eastern and Western martial traditions meet in surprising ways. Kleber visits local practitioners of Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA), trying German and Italian longsword techniques first-hand and seeing how Chinese enthusiasts innovate by combining European swordsmanship with ancient Chinese military manuals. The episode also follows the rise of BUHURT, a European-style armored combat sport now gaining traction in China, featuring locally made traditional Chinese armour in intense full-contact bouts. Through Kleber’s own multicultural martial arts studio and the city’s everyday East-West blend, the episode shows Shanghai as a global hub, a place where classical martial arts find new life and cross-cultural practices thrive.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chongqing
programme.desc: Welcome to Chongqing, China's largest city. Located in the country's southwest, it straddles two mighty rivers and is famed for its extraordinary skyline, with high-rises mushrooming out of the hills and vertigo-inducing bridges.But Tianran He and Angela Fu are here for the food: From xiaomian noodles and Jianghu cuisine to the city's most famous dish: Chongqing hotpot, our hosts take on the spicy, numbing and scintillating aromas of Chongqing cuisine. We promise you: Chongqing will electrify your senses and tantalise your taste buds.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-5 Xingyi Quan
programme.desc: In Episode 5, Kleber travels to Shanxi, the birthplace of Xingyi Quan. He follows Master Cao Bing, a traditional Xingyi Quan teacher and modern combat coach, from Taiyuan’s noodle shops to Pingyao’s ancient streets, and from centuries-old vinegar breweries to Guandi temples, exploring Xingyi Quan’s deep links to Shanxi’s merchant culture and history. Master Cao breaks down the core principles of the “Five Elements and Twelve Forms”, and shows in his modern gym how techniques found in Muay Thai and Jiu-Jitsu can be integrated without losing Xingyi Quan’s philosophical core, guided by the mindset of taking only what is essential. Set against ancient sites such as Yongle Palace, this episode shows how true inner strength is like traditional timber architecture: stable, balanced, and built from within.

programme.title: Foodwise: Great Walls of Beijing
programme.desc: The Great Wall of China is a popular tourist destination, but did you know that in Beijing, it's where locals go to unwind? From feasts of tofu made using well-water and fish caught fresh from the reservoir, to bubbling cauldrons of thinly-sliced lamb, the hilly suburbs of Beijing are home to some of the city's best-loved weekend escapes - and they're all by the foot of the Great Wall.

programme.title: Foodwise: How to Order Chinese Food
programme.desc: How do you order Chinese food? What's the best way to pair dishes? And what's up with the naming system? In this episode, hosts Tianran and Eva will give you a crash course on everything from deciphering the menu and choosing the right restaurant, to pairing dishes according to color, aroma, taste, and form, so that by the end of the show, you too can feast your friends like a pro.

programme.title: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade: A Traditional Chinese Silk Craft
programme.desc: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade, a traditional Chinese silk handicraft with a history spanning over 1,600 years, derives its name from its radiant and resplendent hues, which resemble clouds in the sky. Renowned for its exquisite materials, meticulous weaving techniques, and vibrant, splendid patterns, Yunjin Brocade is hailed as the "king of brocades." It represents the pinnacle of Chinese silk weaving techniques, encapsulates the essence of Chinese silk craftsmanship, and stands as a brilliant crystallization of China’s silk culture. The core technique of Yunjin Brocade weaving—known as "weaving through the warp and cutting the weft"—is executed manually by two artisans working above and below complex, large-scale looms. Using materials such as silk floss, gold thread, and peacock feather threads, they create luxurious fabrics like imperial dragon robes. To this day, Yunjin Brocade continues to be used in crafting high-end clothing and souvenirs. Creating Yunjin Brocade involves over 120 intricate and sophisticated processes before the final masterpiece takes shape. Having traversed over a millennium, its majestic and luxurious aura remains unchanged. Just like the Qinhuai River, which has flowed through Nanjing for over 3,000 years—clear and steadfast—its gentle currents cut through the annals of history as it journeys toward an even more distant future.

programme.title: How can traditional craftsmanship stay relevant in a modern world?
programme.desc: In this story, designer Lan Yu explores how Su embroidery – one of China's most refined textile traditions – is evolving beyond preservation, and into contemporary fashion. From museum heritage to global runways, this is a story about culture, adaptation and reinvention.

programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu
programme.desc: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous "mala" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai’s Yushu Prefecture is one of China’s key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders’ daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.2
programme.desc: Sichuan's western mountains are a shield safeguarding a true national treasure: the Chengdu Plain, China's very own land of plenty. Join us as we dive from high plateaus into deep gorges, scale snow peaks, and follow rivers in pursuit of an engineering marvel bequeathed by the ancients...

programme.title: How can traditional craftsmanship stay relevant in a modern world?
programme.desc: In this story, designer Lan Yu explores how Su embroidery – one of China's most refined textile traditions – is evolving beyond preservation, and into contemporary fashion. From museum heritage to global runways, this is a story about culture, adaptation and reinvention.

programme.title: China's Ancient “Wall Street”: Pingyao
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Pingyao – the ancient "Wall Street" of China and a historic banking hub. Enclosed by ancient city walls and seemingly frozen in time, this entire city, together with two nearby ancient temples, offers a one-of-a-kind adventure at this UNESCO World Heritage Site!

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-5 Xingyi Quan
programme.desc: In Episode 5, Kleber travels to Shanxi, the birthplace of Xingyi Quan. He follows Master Cao Bing, a traditional Xingyi Quan teacher and modern combat coach, from Taiyuan’s noodle shops to Pingyao’s ancient streets, and from centuries-old vinegar breweries to Guandi temples, exploring Xingyi Quan’s deep links to Shanxi’s merchant culture and history. Master Cao breaks down the core principles of the “Five Elements and Twelve Forms”, and shows in his modern gym how techniques found in Muay Thai and Jiu-Jitsu can be integrated without losing Xingyi Quan’s philosophical core, guided by the mindset of taking only what is essential. Set against ancient sites such as Yongle Palace, this episode shows how true inner strength is like traditional timber architecture: stable, balanced, and built from within.

programme.title: Foodwise: Great Walls of Beijing
programme.desc: The Great Wall of China is a popular tourist destination, but did you know that in Beijing, it's where locals go to unwind? From feasts of tofu made using well-water and fish caught fresh from the reservoir, to bubbling cauldrons of thinly-sliced lamb, the hilly suburbs of Beijing are home to some of the city's best-loved weekend escapes - and they're all by the foot of the Great Wall.

programme.title: Foodwise: How to Order Chinese Food
programme.desc: How do you order Chinese food? What's the best way to pair dishes? And what's up with the naming system? In this episode, hosts Tianran and Eva will give you a crash course on everything from deciphering the menu and choosing the right restaurant, to pairing dishes according to color, aroma, taste, and form, so that by the end of the show, you too can feast your friends like a pro.

programme.title: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade: A Traditional Chinese Silk Craft
programme.desc: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade, a traditional Chinese silk handicraft with a history spanning over 1,600 years, derives its name from its radiant and resplendent hues, which resemble clouds in the sky. Renowned for its exquisite materials, meticulous weaving techniques, and vibrant, splendid patterns, Yunjin Brocade is hailed as the "king of brocades." It represents the pinnacle of Chinese silk weaving techniques, encapsulates the essence of Chinese silk craftsmanship, and stands as a brilliant crystallization of China’s silk culture. The core technique of Yunjin Brocade weaving—known as "weaving through the warp and cutting the weft"—is executed manually by two artisans working above and below complex, large-scale looms. Using materials such as silk floss, gold thread, and peacock feather threads, they create luxurious fabrics like imperial dragon robes. To this day, Yunjin Brocade continues to be used in crafting high-end clothing and souvenirs. Creating Yunjin Brocade involves over 120 intricate and sophisticated processes before the final masterpiece takes shape. Having traversed over a millennium, its majestic and luxurious aura remains unchanged. Just like the Qinhuai River, which has flowed through Nanjing for over 3,000 years—clear and steadfast—its gentle currents cut through the annals of history as it journeys toward an even more distant future.

programme.title: Las Plantas
programme.desc: Florencia es una chica de 17 años que debe hacerse cargo de su hermano, que se encuentra en estado vegetativo. Tratando de sobrevivir sola y con problemas financieros, Florencia comenzará a quedar con desconocidos por internet y acabará obsesionándose con un cómic llamado -Las Plantas-, que trata de la invasión de unos espiritus vegetales en los cuerpos humanos cuando sale la luna llena.

programme.title: La Boleta
programme.desc: La vida de Pablo es una serie de eventos desafortunados. Después de un intento de suicidio fallido, tiene un sueño con números ganadores de lotería. Sin embargo, cuando va a comprar un billete, es asaltado. Sin dejarse desanimar, Pablo cree que los números aún serán ganadores y persigue a los ladrones por un barrio pobre.

programme.title: La Buena Nueva
programme.desc: Miguel es nombrado sacerdote de una parroquia en un pueblo socialista durante la sublevación de 1936. Este joven párroco terminará por enfrentarse a la jerarquía eclesiástica y al ejercito español para defender a los represaliados durante la guerra civil española.

programme.title: Cuatro de Copas
programme.desc: Tres amigos, que después de una noche de alcohol no recuerdan nada de la noche anterior.

programme.title: Lo Peor de los Deseos
programme.desc: En la lucha por controlar un sindicato de choferes para satisfacer caprichos personales, hay un traidor latente en cada uno de los implicados.

programme.title: La vida mancha
programme.desc: Fito, jugador empedernido, casado y con un hijo, lleva mucho tiempo sin ver a su hermano mayor Pedro. Pedro vuelve solo para pasar un rato con su hermano. Esta breve y banal visita les va a cambiar la vida.

programme.title: Las chicas del tercero
programme.desc: Dos hermanas, Celia y Aida, llevan una vida tranquila en el barrio de Chacarita, donde chismean sobre sus vecinos. Esperan con ansias la llegada de Marita, la hija de Aida que vive en Canadá, quien las llevará a Toronto para cuidarlas en su vejez.

programme.title: Krampack
programme.desc: Una historia española sobre la mayoría de edad que se centra en las travesuras de dos jóvenes de 17 años, que tienen una lujosa casa en la playa casi para ellos solos un verano. Este es un verano de despertares sexuales.

programme.title: Yatterman
programme.desc: La hermosa y ultra sexy Doronjo y sus malvados esbirros, sedientos de dinero, fama y poder, intentan recuperar los pedazos de una legendaria piedra con poderes misteriosos. Pero sus planes se verán interrumpidos por Gan, Ai y su fiel perro robot gigante, quienes iniciarán una frenética carrera contrarreloj para impedir que la gema caiga en manos de los villanos.

programme.title: El valle Oscuro
programme.desc: Un jinete solitario llega a un remoto y aislado pueblo de los Alpes austríacos, donde, a pesar de no ser bienvenido, se le permite quedarse antes del duro invierno. Se presenta como un fotógrafo de Estados Unidos, pero nadie sospecha que el misterioso extranjero ha llegado al valle para cumplir una venganza. La violencia flota en el aire en este pueblo de leñadores, dominado por un viejo clan familiar que impone sus leyes, aterrorizando a sus habitantes.

programme.title: Tormenta nuclear
programme.desc: Las alarmas se disparan en una central nuclear, que para colmo, se ve afectada por una tormenta de gran intensidad. Los encargados deberán hacer frente a esta situación para evitar una catástrofe.

programme.title: Scarecrow
programme.desc: Seis estudiantes de secundaria se enfrentan a una entidad maligna mientras cumplen su castigo antes del festival del espantapájaros del pueblo.

programme.title: Ace Bodyguard
programme.desc: Esta película cuenta la historia de Zhang Han, un guardaespaldas de élite «retirado», que une fuerzas con su antiguo compañero para rescatar a su esposa secuestrada.

programme.title: Robot Apocalypse
programme.desc: Cuando la experta hacker Tara intenta detener a una poderosa inteligencia artificial que se apodera del ejército mundial, la inteligencia artificial la considera una terrorista que debe ser exterminada.

programme.title: Ataque en el Aire
programme.desc: Unos agentes rusos secuestran un avión comercial estadounidense y planean estrellarlo contra una central nuclear cerca de Washington D.C., lo que provocará una lluvia radiactiva que devastará la costa este. Con poco tiempo para que los cazas de la Fuerza Aérea lo derriben, los pasajeros y la tripulación del avión deben confiar en su propia formación militar y civil para detener a los terroristas antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Vacaciones en el Infierno
programme.desc: Detenido y encarcelado en una prisión mexicana por tráfico de drogas, un hombre aprende a sobrevivir en este entorno hostil con la ayuda de un niño de 9 años.

programme.title: La Noche nunca Duerme
programme.desc: En el transcurso de una sola noche, el sargento de Crímenes Callejeros de Nueva York Thomas Cavanaugh (Dan Brennan) y sus compañeros Rourke (Stephanie Finochio) y Jablonsky (Robert Clohessy) persiguen a los asesinos de uno de los miembros de su grupo de trabajo, buscando información entre los sórdidos habitantes de un barrio infestado de delincuencia.

programme.title: Rabia
programme.desc: Una mujer desarrolla el gusto por la sangre humana después de una cirugía plástica experimental, y sus víctimas se convierten en zombis sedientos de sangre, lo que lleva a una epidemia en toda la ciudad.

programme.title: Corrupción policial
programme.desc: Un policía negro descubre una célula de vigilantes supremacistas blancos dentro de su departamento.

programme.title: Contract Killers
programme.desc: Traicionado por aquellos en los que más confiaba, un asesino a sueldo novato del gobierno descubre que es el objetivo del asesino más peligroso del mundo y así comienza un despiadado juego de matar primero o morir.

programme.title: Experimento Filadelfia
programme.desc: El intento por recrear un antiguo experimento secreto del gobierno fracasa y provoca un agujero espaciotemporal que hace que reaparezca el USS Eldridge, un acorazado de la Segunda Guerra Mundial que desapareció hace más de 70 años. Solo el único superviviente de la nave, acompañado por su nieta, una brillante científica, podrá detener la embarcación antes de que destroce el planeta.

programme.title: Citadel
programme.desc: Tommy es testigo impotente de la agresión que una banda de niños encapuchados perpetran contra su mujer embarazada. El bebé logra sobrevivir, pero ella queda en coma. Tras esto, Tommy desarrolla una agorafobia aguda, y empieza a sospechar que los niños le están siguiendo. Un cura le advertirá de forma críptica que vigile sus espaldas, pues es muy posible que estos quieran arrebatarle también a su hija. Pero… ¿qué son en realidad estas pequeñas criaturas?

programme.title: Hydra
programme.desc: Un ex marine ha sido secuestrado junto a tres convictos, llevado a una isla desierta y obligado a participar en un juego mortal. Los superricos pagan una fortuna por cazar presas humanas. Pero la isla no está desierta: es el hogar de Hydra la Bestia.

programme.title: La saison des Requins
programme.desc: Trois kayakistes luttent pour leur vie lorsqu'un grand requin blanc les piège sur une petite île en train de sombrer.

programme.title: Chroniques de mutants
programme.desc: À la fin de l'ère glaciaire, La Machine est venue de l'espace pour transformer les hommes en mutants. Cependant, un héros a vaincu cet engin et un grand sceau a été apposé sur La Machine. En 2707, le monde épuisé est gouverné par quatre corporations : Mishima, Bauhaus, Capitol et Imperial, qui sont en état de guerre permanent

programme.title: Dystopia
programme.desc: Nous sommes en 2037. Notre monde se meurt lentement d'un virus qui a rendu l'humanité stérile. Aucun enfant n'est né depuis 25 ans. Les gouvernements sont devenus les marionnettes impuissantes des plus grandes entreprises et Biocorp, la plus grande du monde, ne cesse de promettre un remède qui ne viendra jamais

programme.title: Le Meurtrier
programme.desc: Dans ce thriller d'action haletant, un chauffeur de taxi de Yanji, dans la préfecture autonome coréenne de Yanbian, au nord-est de la Chine, se rend en Corée du Sud à la demande d'un gangster local qui lui propose d'éliminer un professeur en échange du remboursement de sa dette. Parallèlement, il recherche sa femme, venue le rejoindre mais sans nouvelles depuis six mois. Ses soupçons d'infidélité le rongent, jusqu'à ce qu'un événement inattendu survienne cette nuit-là. Alors qu'il s'apprête à tuer le professeur, il se retrouve bientôt en fuite, traqué par la police et la mafia, donnant lieu à de violents combats et à d'intenses courses-poursuites.

programme.title: Fatal Instinct
programme.desc: Un détective de police suit une piste d'indices qui semble finalement mener au frère ex-détenu de son partenaire de confiance, qu'il a aidé à mettre en prison il y a des années.

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond est un blanchisseur d'argent à New York qui se réveille sans aucun souvenir, avec des millions de dollars en espèces volées et de la drogue. Il doit rapidement parcourir les rues à la recherche de réponses tout en essayant d'échapper à une équipe de policiers violents et corrompus.

programme.title: La Prison
programme.desc: UN ANCIEN POLICIER CONDAMNÉ REJOINT UN SYNDICAT DU CRIME SECRET AU SEIN DE LA PRISONYu-gon (KIM Rae-won), ancien inspecteur de police tourmenté, est incarcéré pour un délit de fuite. En prison, il découvre que tout l’établissement est contrôlé par un détenu nommé Ik-ho (HAN Seok-kyu), qui dirige un syndicat du crime avec l’aide du directeur et des gardiens, leur fournissant ainsi l’alibi parfait. Rapidement, Yu-gon devient un membre clé de l’empire criminel d’Ik-ho.

programme.title: Héritage
programme.desc: Lors d'un voyage de chasse dans la région sauvage isolée, un père et son fils adolescent adoptif sont transformés en proies d'agresseurs inconnus. Ils sont rejoints dans leur lutte pour la survie par un étranger qui révèle la troublante vérité sur le père biologique du fils, un seigneur du crime international, et pourquoi ce seigneur du crime a envoyé des assassins entraînés pour tuer l'adolescent.

programme.title: Grid Runners
programme.desc: Un scientifique donne vie à des personnages de réalité virtuelle. Deux d'entre eux sont des femmes du site de jeu cybersexe. Le troisième est un guerrier qui veut libérer le reste des méchants du monde souterrain de la réalité virtuelle. Un policier des frontières doit vaincre le guerrier de la réalité virtuelle tout en apprenant à se comporter avec l'une des femmes du cybersexe.

programme.title: Funeral Killers
programme.desc: Un jeu du chat et de la souris se déroule au cours d'une seule nuit, lorsque trois criminels armés font irruption dans une morgue et exigent que le médecin légiste et son assistant leur remettent une balle logée dans un cadavre. Alors que les criminels tentent désespérément de cacher leur véritable identité, le médecin se retrouve de plus en plus enlisé dans un bourbier, son passé le rattrapant malgré lui. Chaque rebondissement explosif pousse bientôt les personnages au-delà de leurs limites.

programme.title: Battle Drone
programme.desc: 6 mercenaires sont engagés par la CIA pour enlever l'héritier d'une république et éliminer un marchand d'armes à Moscou et reçoivent une autre mission à Tchernobyl où la trahison les attend.

programme.title: Awaken
programme.desc: Un groupe de personnes se réveille sur une île où elles sont pourchassées.

programme.title: Les Rebelles de PT-218
programme.desc: En pleine Seconde Guerre mondiale, l'océan Atlantique devient un champ de bataille mortel lorsqu'un torpilleur américain se bat contre le bombardement constant des forces allemandes

programme.title: La Belle Au Bois Dormant
programme.desc: Suite à un sort jeté par une fée Maléfique, la princesse Aurore tombe dans un sommeil profond le jour de ses 16 ans. Seul le baiser d’un prince pourra l’éveiller mais la sorcière Tambria qui a pris possession du château de l’héritière ne compte pas laisser quiconque aider sa victime.

programme.title: The eXtremists
programme.desc: Une équipe de tournage se rend dans les Alpes autrichiennes, près de l’ancienne frontière yougoslave, pour filmer trois passionnés de sports extrêmes poursuivis par une avalanche pour une publicité. Ce qu’ils ignorent, c’est qu’ils tournent à proximité de la cachette secrète de Slobodan Pavle, un criminel de guerre serbe. L’ayant accidentellement filmé, ils se retrouvent entraînés dans une course-poursuite mortelle à travers les montagnes, mêlant ski, snowboard, parachutisme, rafting, hélicoptères, motos et base jump.

programme.title: Los McMasters
programme.desc: Cuando un veterano negro de la Guerra Civil se convierte en copropietario del rancho sureño de los McMasters, los indignados veteranos confederados locales vienen a por él y su esposa india.

programme.title: Sandokan Contro Il Leopardo Di Sarawak
programme.desc: Tra giungle e mari esotici, Sandokan sfida il temibile Leopardo di Sarawak in una lotta tra vendetta e libertà, tra duelli e battaglie spettacolari.

programme.title: Erode Il Grande
programme.desc: Tra potere, intrighi e tensioni di corte, Erode difende il trono affrontando tradimenti e scelte che segnano il destino del regno

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: El inspector Leduque llega de Nueva Orleans a Virginia City para detener a Ben Cartwright por un asesinato cometido hace 20 años. Cuando Ben declara públicamente que se retira de la carrera por la gobernación, la gente del pueblo se molesta no sólo por esto, sino que Little Joe también ha sido acusado de matar a tiros a sangre fría al ayudante de Leduque.

programme.title: El angel vengador
programme.desc: Miles Utley es un comando/guardaespaldas mormón profesional que se ve obligado a convertirse en renegado y a cuestionar su fe cuando investiga un escándalo de asesinato y especulación de tierras.

programme.title: Il Vecchio Testamento
programme.desc: Dalla creazione ai grandi profeti, episodi biblici prendono vita tra miracoli, prove e destini che segnano la storia dell’umanità.

programme.title: La mujer que atracó la diligencia
programme.desc: Esta película, una de las 12 películas del Oeste realizadas en 12 meses durante 2020, cuenta la historia real de Pearl Hart, interpretada por Lorraine Etchell, una mujer que pasa por una serie de malas relaciones con los hombres, hasta que finalmente se pasa a la vida criminal con un vagabundo europeo llamado Joe Boot (Travis Mills). Juntos deciden robar una diligencia, lo que convierte a Pearl en una de las forajidas más famosas de todos los tiempos.

programme.title: Barabba
programme.desc: Liberato al posto di Gesù, il brigante Barabba vive tormentato dal dubbio su chi fosse davvero l’uomo condannato alla croce.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP19 - Los asesinos a sueldo
programme.desc: Hoss y Little Joe son confundidos con sanguinarios asesinos a sueldo en un pequeño pueblo de Texas dominado por dos familias enemistadas.

programme.title: Banda de rebeldes
programme.desc: Un grupo de soldados confederados utiliza sus habilidades únicas para viajar tras las líneas enemigas y llevar a cabo misiones mortales que causan estragos en el ejército de la Unión.

programme.title: I Dieci Gladiatori
programme.desc: Dieci guerrieri vengono scelti per una missione decisiva tra duelli, intrighi e battaglie che possono cambiare il destino di Roma.

programme.title: El Hombre de Utah
programme.desc: En un concurso de equitación, los malos quieren que John Weston pierda. Cuando éste se niega, añaden un seguro: una aguja envenenada justo debajo de su montura.

programme.title: El calle de los conflictos
programme.desc: Un sheriff intenta detener los conflictos entre colonos en el Oeste tras la Guerra de Secesión.

programme.title: Erik Il Vichingo
programme.desc: Tra terre nordiche e battaglie epiche, il guerriero Erik affronta nemici e tradimenti in una lotta per onore e potere, tra duelli e conquiste. Diretto da Mario Caiano con Giuliano Gemma.

programme.title: El último hijo
programme.desc: Un forajido intenta acabar con su descendencia eliminando a su malvada línea consanguínea.

programme.title: Zorro Contro Maciste
programme.desc: Tra duelli e imprese eroiche, Zorro e Maciste uniscono le forze contro un potere tirannico, tra azione e colpi di scena. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi

programme.title: Giuseppe Venduto Dai Fratelli
programme.desc: Tradito dai fratelli e venduto come schiavo, Giuseppe affronta prove durissime in Egitto fino a diventare uomo di fiducia del faraone.

programme.title: Corsicana
programme.desc: El ayudante del sheriff Bass Reeves se reencuentra con su antiguo compañero y fugitivo Sam Tanner. Junto con un antiguo francotirador de la Unión, se enfrentan a una carrera contrarreloj para seguir la pista de Jack Donner y su despiadada banda de asesinos.

programme.title: I Sette Gladiatori
programme.desc: Un grande film d'avventura con scontri fino all'ultimo sangue. Il gladiatore Dario, libero grazie alle sue vittorie, torna in patria. Qui, al posto del padre che vi governava, trova un tiranno usurpatore che l'ha ucciso. Con l'aiuto di sei validi combattenti, cercherà di rimettere tutto al proprio posto.

programme.title: Matar Caballería
programme.desc: El general estadounidense Hudson Kilpatrick es conocido por muchos como la "Matar Caballería", no por el número de tropas enemigas que ha matado, sino por las suyas propias, debido a decisiones atroces que provocaron numerosas bajas.

programme.title: Maciste All'inferno
programme.desc: Tra inferi, magie oscure e creature demoniache, Maciste affronta una sfida estrema per salvare innocenti dal male.

programme.title: Tu Cabeza vale mas de 1000 dolares
programme.desc: Para cumplir el último deseo de su madre, un cazarrecompensas intenta encontrar a su hermanastro, un desertor confederado convertido en delincuente, y entregarlo a la ley.

programme.title: Maciste Contro I Cacciatori Di Teste
programme.desc: In terre selvagge e misteriose, Maciste sfida tribù feroci e pericoli mortali per salvare innocenti e ristabilire la pace.

programme.title: El Hombre el orgullo y la venganza
programme.desc: Un incondicional soldado español recurre a la delincuencia para demostrar su amor por una misteriosa y promiscua gitana.

programme.title: La Vendetta Dei Gladiatori
programme.desc: Nell’antica Roma, un eroe affronta tradimenti e duelli mortali per vendicare il proprio popolo e sfidare il potere

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Jeb Drummond es un pastor de ovejas asesino que ha tomado a Adam como rehén para intentar obligar a Ben a cederle una gran parte de las tierras de Ponderosa.

programme.title: Buen Funeral Amigos paga Sartana
programme.desc: Cuando una joven hereda una mina de oro de su tío asesinado, Sartana acude en su ayuda mientras varios estafadores, incluido el sheriff local, intentan reclamarla como suya.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Gladiatore
programme.desc: Diretto da Alfonso Brescia con Mark Forest, un gladiatore affronta tiranni e tradimenti in una Roma dominata dal potere.

programme.title: Yellow Rock
programme.desc: Cinco hombres cabalgan hacia el inquietante pueblo de Yellow Rock, con la esperanza de rescatar a un familiar y a su hijo perdido.

programme.title: I Coltelli Del Vendicatore
programme.desc: Tra intrighi e vendetta in un’ambientazione nordica, un uomo combatte contro tradimenti e usurpatori per ristabilire giustizia, tra duelli e colpi di scena. Diretto da Mario Bava e Leopoldo Savona.

programme.title: El Gran Duelo
programme.desc: Un ex sheriff canoso ayuda a un hombre acusado de asesinato a enfrentarse al poderoso trío de hermanos.

programme.title: Giovanni Dalle Bande Nere
programme.desc: Diretto da Sergio Grieco,con protagonista Vittorio Gassman. Nel pieno delle guerre rinascimentali, il valoroso condottiero Giovanni dalle Bande Nere guida le sue truppe tra battaglie e strategie militari, diventando simbolo di coraggio e disciplina.

programme.title: Le Géant de Métropolis
programme.desc: Muscleman Ohro se rend dans la capitale pécheresse de l'Atlantide pour réprimander son impiété et son orgueil, et s'engage dans la bataille contre son seigneur maléfique Yoh-tar et ses plans hideux de super-science.

programme.title: Texas
programme.desc: A Dallas, un ancien soldat de l'Union tente de démasquer une conspiration de Sudistes qui ont assassiné son père, son ami et le Président.

programme.title: Le pistolero de Tombstone
programme.desc: Un homme est faussement accusé de vol de banque, ce qui pousse son frère à le faire sortir de prison. Ensemble, ils partent à la recherche des vrais coupables et leur quête les mène à une bande de hors-la-loi dirigée par un célèbre bandit armé.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un puissant gang sévit à Virginia City en se livrant à un racket de protection meurtrier, les Cartwright sont déterminés à l'arrêter même s'il les menace.

programme.title: Ta tombe est prête Sartana !
programme.desc: Deux cow-boys se font voler leur or dans les montagnes rocheuses et décident de se défendre en affrontant les bandits.

programme.title: La Charge des Cosaques
programme.desc: L'histoire de Hadji Murad, un chef tchétchène du XIXe siècle qui a mené ses guerriers dans une lutte contre les forces d'invasion du tsar russe.

programme.title: Retour a Legend City
programme.desc: Enfant, il a vu son père prédicateur se faire assassiner. En tant que soldat, il a été témoin des horreurs de la guerre civile. Aujourd'hui, le chasseur de primes James Conners est de retour à Legend, au Nouveau-Mexique, pour capturer le baron terrien psychotique qui a détruit son enfance.

programme.title: O Cangaceiro
programme.desc: Après avoir pillé et massacré un village, le chef d'une bande de bandits, le capitaine Jagunço, enlève Flô, l'épouse du maire Cisso, et la torture.

programme.title: Le temps des vautours
programme.desc: Engagé par un propriétaire terrien mexicain pour sauver sa fille des mains d'un bandit, un chasseur de primes décide finalement de se joindre au malfaiteur pour un braquage afin d'obtenir une meilleure récompense, ce qui aboutit à une trahison tragique.

programme.title: Buckaroo ne pardonne pas
programme.desc: Al arrive dans la ville dirigée par Lash qui a pris possession d'une mine d'or et cherche maintenant à récupérer l'autre, qui appartient au vieux Johnny. Al est le seul à soutenir Johnny mais le vieil homme est quand même pris en embuscade et tué.

programme.title: Adios Gringo
programme.desc: Un cow-boy tente de laver son nom en chassant les voleurs de bétail qui l'ont piégé en lui faisant acheter du bétail volé et qui sont également responsables du viol d'une jeune femme qu'il aide à se rétablir.

programme.title: On l'appelle Trinita
programme.desc: Un tireur paresseux et peu orthodoxe et son frère corpulent et voleur de chevaux défendent une colonie mormone contre un major accapareur de terres, un bandit mexicain et leurs hommes de main.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: On continue à l'appeller Trinita
programme.desc: Bambino essaie d'apprendre à son frère Trinity comment devenir un hors-la-loi, mais ils finissent par sauver une famille de pionniers et à défaire un réseau de contrebande.

programme.title: Hercule contre les tyrans de Babylone
programme.desc: Le roi Shalmaneser, Assur et sa sœur sorcière Tanit, tyrans de Babylone, retiennent prisonniers des Hellènes, dont Esperia, reine d'Hellas. Hercule intervient pour la sauver, punir les tyrans cruels et libérer le peuple.

programme.title: Les Aigles noirs de Santa Fe
programme.desc: Lorsque les Comanches se mettent sur le sentier de la guerre, les colons se réfugient à Fort Eagle Rock, commandé par le capitaine Jackson. L'agent secret Cliff McPherson arrive dans ce fort en sous-effectif pour donner des conseils et apporter son soutien. Il apprend que les Comanches ont été attisés par Morton, un éleveur local qui veut prendre le contrôle du pétrole situé sous la réserve des Indiens.

programme.desc: Historias de crimen que marcaron a la sociedad mexicana, narradas por reporteros que cubrieron los casos.
